recipient_selection.title: Recipient — Selection
recipient_selection.description: Select the type of recipient to create. System recipients handle system-wide channels, HA User recipients are linked to Home Assistant users, and Virtual recipients are custom entries.

data_description.recipient_choice: Choose from available system channels, Home Assistant users not yet configured, or create a custom virtual recipient.

recipient_definition.title: Recipient — Definition
recipient_definition.description: Define name, email address, phone number, and mobile device ID for the recipient.

data_description.email: Note: Only needed if an email based notification channel is configured.
data_description.phone: Note: Only needed if a phone based notification channel is configured.

recipient_basic_settings.title: Recipient — Basic Settings
recipient_basic_settings.description: Configure retry, rate limits and the notification types the recipient should receive.

recipient_tts_settings.title: TTS Settings
recipient_tts_settings.description: Configure volume levels and message format for text-to-speech delivery. Volume levels are applied based on the current time of day.

data_description.volume_morning: Volume level (0-100) for notifications delivered between 6:00 AM and 9:00 AM.
data_description.volume_daytime: Volume level (0-100) for notifications delivered between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM.
data_description.volume_evening: Volume level (0-100) for notifications delivered between 6:00 PM and 10:00 PM.
data_description.volume_night: Volume level (0-100) for notifications delivered between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM.
data_description.volume_override_level: Volume level (0-100) to use when a notification matches the override criticalities below.
data_description.volume_override_criticalities: Select criticality levels that should use the override volume instead of time-based volumes (e.g., always play CRITICAL notifications at maximum volume).
data_description.message_format: Choose how notification content is formatted for TTS: 'Title and Message' speaks both, 'Message Only' speaks just the message, 'Title Only' speaks just the title.
data_description.trailing_silence_ms: Extra silence (in milliseconds) to append after the message as an SSML <break> tag if the value is greater than 0. This helps prevent the end of the message from being cut off (e.g., to compensate for buffer clearing in Snapcast). If set to 0, no extra silence is added.

recipient_channel_mapping.title: Recipient — Channel Mapping
recipient_channel_mapping.description: Map notification criticality levels to delivery channels.

recipient_dnd_settings.title: Recipient — Do Not Disturb (DND) Settings
recipient_dnd_settings.description: Configure quiet hours and DND behavior for the recipient.
